data.description:
## Why
The hourly CI host gate skips a quarantine list (`.github/workflows/ci-hourly.yml`, `HOST_TEST_QUARANTINE`). During the c11 1.0 run, fixes landed whose regression tests sit in quarantined classes, so CI never runs them:
- `c11Tests/GhosttyConfigTests` holds the regression test for C11-311 B083.
- The close-guard class quarantined by C11-253 holds the test for C11-250's close fix.
- `c11Tests/AppDelegateShortcutRoutingTests` had 17 failures on main as a baseline (confirmed 2026-10-02 18:20), so it is quarantined rather than fixed.

## Done when
- Each class above is either back in the host gate and green, or its new-fix tests move to `c11LogicTests` where they run.
- The 17 baseline failures in `AppDelegateShortcutRoutingTests` are fixed or each one is deleted with a reason.
- The quarantine list carries a comment naming why each remaining class is there.

Source: c11 1.0 run retro, run-state entries 16:03, 16:30 and 18:20 on 2026-10-02.
data.title: Un-quarantine the host test classes that now guard 1.0 fixes

data.body:
PR https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/588, head ff6b4ada98 (gated head 2f9513a67e plus one notes-only commit). Tests, CI and notes only; no Sources/ change.

All seven C11-109 class exclusions are removed from HOST_TEST_QUARANTINE. Every remaining exclusion is one method with a one-line reason.

Per class:
- GhosttyConfigTests (B083 guard), NotificationBurstCoalescerTests, TerminalNotificationDirectInteractionTests, WorkspaceManagerReopenClosedBrowserFocusTests: already passed. Un-quarantined as is.
- BrowserDeveloperToolsVisibilityPersistenceTests (guards two C11-287 tests): 8 stale tests repaired. The fake attach() counted a show; tests acted inside the show transition; one fixture leaked a detached-inspector window.
- BrowserTabHostContainerViewTests: 7 stale fixtures repaired. Divider routing requires side-dock promotion (upstream 06c5cac4df).
- AppDelegateShortcutRoutingTests (guards C11-250 close guard, C11-266 quick view, B050 quit flush): of the 10 failing tests (the 17-assertion baseline), 8 were stale and are repaired. The default 2x2 grid and welcome quad added panes; Cmd+N now opens the picker; strong window refs hid closes; the real palette overlay shadowed the fixture; Cmd+W on a non-main window passes through; an idle shell needs a prompt-idle report; Cmd+D raced the key-window resync. 2 are a real product bug and stay method-quarantined (below). The class now runs in its own xcodebuild invocation (below).

Product bug, still quarantined (testAddWorkspaceInPreferredMainWindowPrunesOrphanedContextWithoutLiveWindow, testCustomCmdTNewWorkspacePrunesOrphanedContextWithoutLiveWindow):
- Scenario: a main-window context whose NSWindow was freed without a will-close notification.
- Expected: the next workspace creation prunes it.
- Actual: every candidate in preferredMainWindowContextForWorkspaceCreation requires a resolved window, so the discard after a failed resolution in addWorkspaceInPreferredMainWindow is unreachable. The orphan stays in mainWindowContexts and in window summaries.
- Operator impact is unproven and needs a rare orphan.

Host isolation:
- A probe after AppDelegateShortcutRoutingTests found 70 closed main windows still alive in NSApp.windows, 84 registered surfaces, and a main-queue backlog: the first main.async did not fire within 50 ms. GhosttySurfaceOverlayTests then failed its fixed-wait deferred mounts.
- The class tearDown now frees what each test opened (149 of 149 terminals, previously 0). The windows stay reachable outside test code, so the gate runs this class in a second xcodebuild invocation.
- The flag-banner overlay test now waits for its deferred mount (bounded) instead of a fixed 50 ms.
- Lead, unverified: production may also retain closed main windows and their terminals. One QA check settles it: open and close a second window and confirm that window and its shells deallocate.

Atlas evidence (remote-build --mode test):
- Baseline at main 6e2c1dc47f, seven classes (b2dae594): 50 failed assertions.
- Control at main, full gate with main's quarantine (b44c471d): 1595 tests, 0 failures.
- Exact head 2f9513a67e, clean, the hourly step's selection:
  - c11Tests minus AppDelegate (ffe0294f): 1665 tests, 0 failures, both passes.
  - AppDelegateShortcutRoutingTests alone (ffa5a2f0): 68 tests, 0 failures, both passes.
  - Every 1.0 guard executed and passed.

GitHub-hosted hourly runs have not started since 06:07Z on 2026-10-05: billing is blocking the macOS runners. The hourly gate is dark until that clears.

Side note for upstream triage: upstream removed the private WKInspector attach call (79f3556821) because it can crash in platformAttach. c11 still makes it (BrowserTab prepareDeveloperToolsForRevealIfNeeded).

Review PASS at ff6b4ada98 (Astra, round 1). All seven classes run and pass in the hourly selections; 2 AppDelegateShortcutRoutingTests methods stay excluded with stated reasons. Non-blocking (not fixed, recorded here): BrowserTabTests.swift:1094 full-height divider fixture loses its stale-height witness during setup; ci-hourly.yml quarantine comments say guest QA 'proves' more than it does. PR #588 draft, held until 1.0 releases; lands before C11-335 (both edit ci-hourly.yml).

Merged origin/main 4785de26f9 (C11-337 R8 panel rename, #587) into PR 588. New head 859d3210f2. No Sources/ or submodule diff against main.

Beyond conflict resolution, the merge changed only names:
- TabLifecycleTests -> PanelLifecycleTests in the skip list.
- BrowserTabTests.swift edits carried into BrowserPanelTests.swift as BrowserTab* -> BrowserPanel*.
- The flag-banner wait uses PanelAttentionIndex/PanelAttentionSnapshot.
- updateTabShellActivityState -> updatePanelShellActivityState.

Atlas at 859d3210f2 (clean), the hourly host selections:
- c11Tests minus AppDelegate (079274d5): 1676 tests, 0 failures, both passes.
- AppDelegateShortcutRoutingTests alone (cb1764ee): 68 tests, 0 failures, both passes.

The 25 repaired methods that the panel-rename host attribution counts among its 31 quarantined failures (AppDelegate 10 including the 2 still quarantined, DevTools 8, host container 7) pass at this head. The 6 C11-253 methods stay quarantined. The C11-342 flag-banner fix overlaps this PR's bounded overlay wait, and C11-345 (which absorbed it) may conflict here.

Astra review PASS r1 at ff6b4ada98; rebase onto C11-337 was names only, attested at 859d3210f2 with Atlas 1676+68 host tests green; merged 3fdb7e2317 (#588), merged tree identical to the PR head for all six files.
